Requirement: G < 0.35 V => G < 0.35 (G+S) => G < 0.35G + 0.35S => 0.65G < 0.35S => G < (0.35/0.65)S ≈ 0.53846 S. Solve equality G = 0.53846 S. Initially G=21M, S=8.955M. Let x be amount of GOV sold (converted to stables). Then G = 21M - x, S = 8.955M + x. Plug: 21M - x = 0.53846 (8.955M + x). Solve: 21M - x = 4.819M + 0.53846x => 21M - 4.819M = x + 0.53846x => 16.181M = 1.53846x => x ≈ 10.525M. Therefore sell $10.525M of GOV, leaving G ≈ 10.475M, S ≈ 19.48M, total V ≈ 29.955M.
